document.abstract: Because the high cost, large size and complexity of general purpose mobile TV units may not be justified, it may be more economic to design specialized units for three different applications identified as Live coverage, Drama inserts, and News coverage. The effect on the design of mobile units of lightweight cameras, camera cable and monitors is discussed.
